newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Carryover selling seen on slow packer demand for fed cattle.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Expect increased feeder supplies and corn called higher.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Mixed interior hog calls may bring uneven trade.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Cash weak but has firmed at this level and expect only few deliveries.
